area_responsibilities.architecture: Dependency boundaries, constraints and conformance guidance.
area_responsibilities.authority: Applicable meanings/contracts, owner routes and separately attributable decisions.
area_responsibilities.implementation: Functional source, schemas, fixtures, tests, build/configuration and explicit runtime references.
area_responsibilities.ontology: Authored concepts/relationships and exact input/view selections.
area_responsibilities.product: Purpose, value, capability/feature scope and acceptance.
area_responsibilities.project: Durable coordination identity, owners, dependencies and Goal references.
area_responsibilities.work: Bounded effort, plans, research, tasks, blockers and outcomes.

package_policy: Canonical manifests declare proposal-owned selection artifacts only; external current Craft source stays referenced and unchanged.

self_application.applies_to: Lab develops its own operating model using separately identified Project/Work records.
self_application.stop: Prepare this candidate and one Craft profile; do not recursively provision workspaces for Goals or model artifacts.
